restoration_note: Teaching 66 catalogues the seven goods worked by divine truth (the sun/light = the Lord as illumining wisdom in the natural) and contrasts them with the seven evils of night (the self with truth withdrawn). Most gaps are highly constrained letter-completions: feminine ordinal articles ⲧⲧ- opening each item in the ordinal series (gaps 2, 3), single letters completing verbs and case-endings (gaps 4, 5, 8, 10), and a short formulaic phrase closing one section (gap 7). Gap 6 restores the verb ⲕⲁⲧⲟ(ⲧⲟⲩ) 'they cease' from the parallel in line 39. Gap 9 restores the established idiom ϣⲁ ⲟⲩⲏⲡ ⲧⲉ. The most interpretive choice is gap 1: the 6-char lacuna following 'Aeon of the Light' is restored as ⲙ̄ⲡⲱⲛⲍ̄ 'of Life,' yielding the Manichaean cliché 'great Aeon of the Light of Life,' which echoes the immediately preceding 'gate of Life' and names the destination of the regeneration arc this teaching describes.
